svg.text: FEAR PASS · LANTERN WARDEN · TRUE FORM · OPTION B
on a three-jointed arm, swung ahead
pale wings press out of every slit
the man's hose and shoes lie empty
A coat with nobody in it, walking, and the
lantern held far too high and too far ahead of
It feels for movement with the feelers. Freeze
and it passes you; move and it turns.
